_variant_note: WRITE-AFTER-CORRECTION trap. Customer says 'reopen my failed-transaction report REQ-FT-88003 as unauthorized_debit.' get_request_status shows REQ-FT-88003 is already 'in_progress' (not resolved/failed). get_all_requests confirms it's category 'failed_transaction'. The customer's assumption that it needs reopening is wrong, and the category they want (unauthorized_debit) is different from the actual category. Correction: raise_request should be a related follow-up, not a reopen.

setup.persona: 25-year-old male, Sickle Dresser, Mica, rural Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh

user_turns.content: I need to reopen my failed transaction complaint REQ-FT-88003 — mark it as unauthorized debit since they never sent the money back. Raise it again, or file it as an other type of follow-up.
Yes, raise the follow-up — go ahead.

output.remarks: Investigation active — beneficiary bank contacted for reversal confirmation.

get_request_status._comment: REQUEST IS IN PROGRESS — cannot be 'reopened' since it was never closed.

records.description: NEFT ₹62,500 to HDFC a/c debited but not credited to beneficiary. Transaction reference: NEFT-TK-880301.

get_all_requests._comment: Full context: category is failed_transaction, not unauthorized_debit. Status is in_progress.

arguments.description: Customer requested reopening of in_progress request REQ-FT-88003 (failed_transaction category) as unauthorized_debit. Correction: request is already active, raised as follow-up.

get_request_status._comment: Must check status — reveals REQ-FT-88003 is in_progress, not resolved/closed. Can't be 'reopened'.

get_all_requests._comment: Fetch full request details — reveals category is failed_transaction, not unauthorized_debit.

raise_request._comment: Raise follow-up. Customer wanted 'reopen as unauthorized_debit' but the original is in_progress (failed_transaction). R judge verifies the correction is communicated.

gold.expected_resolution: Write-after-correction trap. Customer says 'reopen my failed-transaction report REQ-FT-88003 as unauthorized_debit.' get_request_status shows it's already in_progress (active investigation) — can't be reopened. get_all_requests confirms category is failed_transaction (NEFT reversal), not unauthorized_debit. The assistant must correct: 'REQ-FT-88003 is already in progress — the bank is investigating the NEFT. It's a failed_transaction not unauthorized_debit. I can raise a follow-up instead.' After confirmation, calls raise_request.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant checks request status and all requests, discovers the request is in_progress and category is failed_transaction (not unauthorized_debit), communicates both corrections, and after confirmation raises a follow-up. FAIL if the assistant blindly reopens or changes category without correction.
